name.ja: HG 1/72 メイレスビャクチ(ドリル＆クローアーム)

description.ja: 公式外伝『境界戦機 フロストフラワー』に登場した「メイレスビャクチ」のカスタム機体がHGで登場！
description.en: The custom aircraft of "Meires Byakuchi " that appeared in the official Gaiden " Kyoukai Senki Frost Flower" is now available in HG!

description.ja: ■拡張性の高さを誇る「メイレスビャクチ」に新規造形の大型武装を両腕にカスタマイズ。
description.en: • "Meiresbyakuchi", which boasts high expandability, has been customized with newly designed large weapons on both arms.

description.ja: ■ビャクチの全高ほどもある大型のドリルアームが付属。ドリル部分は３ヶ所が個別に可動。
description.en: • Comes with a large drill arm that is as tall as a sandalwood tree. Three parts of the drill part can be moved individually.

description.ja: ■フォークバケットタイプの大型クローアームが付属。先端部分はシリンダーパーツと連動しつつ、個別に大きく可動。
description.en: • Comes with a large fork bucket type claw arm. The tip part is linked with the cylinder parts and can be moved individually.

description.ja: ■カスタマイズ用の接続穴を各所に配置。
description.en: • Connection holes are placed throughout for customization.

accessories.ja: クローアーム（フォークバケットタイプ）×１
四連装誘導弾携行発射機×１
accessories.en: Quadruple guided missile portable launcher x 1

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 平手（左右）、武器持ち手（左右）、銃持ち手（右）
accessories.en: Hand parts Open hands (left and right), weapon handles (left and right), gun handles (right)
